biotools.summary: Neuropathological Function Estimations (NeuropM-Box) is a software module designed to analyze neural activity alterations in neurological disorders, offering a user-friendly interface for generating subject-specific functional brain models and decoding neuropathological influences without requiring programming expertise. The tool was validated using Alzheimer's disease data.
